question: Does the versioned face-first gait satisfy both target pursuit and measured gait rejection gates? The earlier startup failure remains a negative control.
before_training: Inspect the existing gait-v3 run and its recorded source hashes before proposing another job; do not duplicate an active run.
Use experiments/laser/gait-correction-v3.json for the current bounded intervention and its fresh reserved-bank gate. Target-only success cannot select its candidate.
Retain baseline reproduction of the visible startup fall and isolate one property group per diagnostic.
Bind model, BAM, reset, action/observation and perturbation schedule; keep policy bytes fixed during property tests.
If asserting physics causality, use saved action tensors; a feedback rollout or parsed JSON action comparison is insufficient.
Specify one intervention, its hypothesis, bounded transition budget and unchanged regression gates from the diagnosis.
Freeze a fresh test bank before the intervention and keep all consumed reserved seeds out of tuning.
Run duck doctor and duck-ops guard immediately before any separately authorized launch; the guard is advisory, not a lease.
boundary: Working focus and inspection only. TRAINING_ACTUALIZATION.md remains the queue. This file does not authorize a launch, choose a new policy or alter any evaluator.
